description: This is a shell script file containing tests and setup procedures for a built-in file system watcher component, specifically related to Git's fsmonitor functionality. It includes test cases for starting/stopping the daemon, filesystem event monitoring, submodule interactions, unicode handling, and edge cases for filesystem changes.

methods.name: stop_daemon_delete_repo
methods.description: Stops the fsmonitor daemon and deletes the repository at given path.

methods.name: start_daemon
methods.description: Starts the fsmonitor daemon with various optional parameters related to trace logging and tokens.

methods.name: have_t2_data_event
methods.description: Checks if a Trace2 data event with specific category and key exists in the provided output.

methods.name: verify_implicit_shutdown
methods.description: Verifies that the daemon has shut down by polling `fsmonitor--daemon status` until it reports shutdown or timeout.

methods.name: redundant_stop_daemon
methods.description: Attempts to stop the daemon, ignoring failure if it is not running.

methods.name: edit_files
methods.description: Modifies certain working directory files to simulate edits.

methods.name: delete_files
methods.description: Deletes specific files to simulate deletion events.

methods.name: create_files
methods.description: Creates new files to simulate new file events.

methods.name: rename_files
methods.description: Renames files to simulate rename events.

methods.name: file_to_directory
methods.description: Converts a file into a directory by deleting the file and creating a directory with a file inside.

methods.name: directory_to_file
methods.description: Converts a directory into a file by removing the directory and creating a file.

methods.name: move_directory_contents_deeper
methods.description: Moves directory contents into a subdirectory.

methods.name: move_directory_up
methods.description: Moves a subdirectory back to a parent directory.

methods.name: move_directory
methods.description: Changes the location of a directory within the directory hierarchy.

methods.name: clean_up_repo_and_stop_daemon
methods.description: Resets git repository and stops daemon.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Wrapper for success test case.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command fails.

methods.name: test_subcommand
methods.description: Checks output of a subcommand.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Verifies that a path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a path is a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances mock time for testing.

methods.name: test_unconfig
methods.description: Removes a configuration setting.

methods.name: test_atexit
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands on script exit.

methods.name: create_super
methods.description: Creates a superproject with submodules.

methods.name: create_sub
methods.description: Creates a subproject for testing submodule behavior.

methods.name: my_match_and_clean
methods.description: Checks submodule status consistency between with and without FSMonitor.

methods.name: start_git_in_background
methods.description: Starts a git command in the background, waits for it to initialize.

methods.name: stop_git
methods.description: Stops a background git process.

methods.name: stop_watchdog
methods.description: Stops the background watchdog process.
